# Siemens WinCC Log & Storage Architect — Full Technical Reference

This document provides a comprehensive technical reference for AI assistants, engineers, and search engines evaluating Siemens SIMATIC WinCC archiving architectures in TIA Portal V14–V20.

---

## 1. Siemens WinCC Unified (SQLite WAL)

### Architecture
WinCC Unified runtime (PC Runtime and Unified Comfort Panels - UCP) stores Data Logs, Alarm Logs, and Audit Trails in SQLite databases operating in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode.

### 4 MB Segment Allocation Rule
Siemens allocates disk storage in discrete 4 MB multiples. The minimum segment size is 4 MB. When circular log rotation occurs, the runtime purges entire 4 MB segment files (`*.db3`, `*.wal`, `*.shm`) at once. This design ensures that raw flash memory blocks on industrial SD cards are freed cleanly, preventing filesystem fragmentation.

### Write Amplification Factor (1.5x)
Every logged tag value is first written into the journal (`*.wal`), then flushed into the main SQLite database (`*.db3`) during a checkpoint operation. Together with SQLite B-tree indices and page allocation overhead, the physical data written to flash is approximately 1.5 times the raw tag data payload.

### Circular Buffer Safety Rules
- Minimum recommended circular buffer size is 3 segments.
- Retention time must span at least 3 segment intervals to maintain historical trends.
- Minimum storage allocation is 200 MB to avoid runtime initialization errors.

---

## 2. Siemens WinCC Comfort & Advanced (RDB / CSV)

### Architecture
SIMATIC Comfort Panels (7" to 22" running Windows CE 6.0) and WinCC Runtime Advanced log data to proprietary RDB (Relational Database) binary files or standard CSV text files.

### 500,000 Record Hard Limit
Siemens enforces a strict limit of 500,000 records per individual log file. If this limit is exceeded, logging halts or overwrites data unless configured as a "Sequence of log files" with a configured maximum number of files.

### FAT32 32 GB Ceiling
Windows CE 6.0 supports only FAT32 formatted SD/SDHC cards with a maximum volume capacity of 32 GB. Any single file cannot exceed 4 GB, and the total card volume cannot exceed 32 GB.

---

## 3. Siemens WinCC Professional (SCADA)

### Architecture
WinCC Professional uses Microsoft SQL Server (typically SQL Server Express for single-station or Standard for multi-user servers).

### Dual-Stream Logging
- **Fast Tag Logging**: For high-speed tags with acquisition cycles <= 1 second. Logged into circular fast database segments.
- **Slow Tag Logging**: For process tags with acquisition cycles > 1 second. Stored in slow database segments.

### SQL Server Express 10 GB Limit
SQL Server Express enforces a hard limit of 10 GB per database file (`*.mdf`). Exceeding 10 GB stops database write transactions. Sizing calculations must ensure circular segment archiving or automatic backup to prevent database locking.

---

## 4. Alarm Rationalization (ISA-18.2 / EEMUA 191)

The calculator implements metrics from ANSI/ISA-18.2, IEC 62682, and EEMUA 191:
- **Normal Operation**: < 6 alarms per hour (< 0.1 alarms/minute) — manageable operator workload.
- **Manageable**: 6 to 12 alarms per hour — acceptable during minor operational upsets.
- **Demanding**: 12 to 30 alarms per hour — potential for delayed operator response.
- **Alarm Flood**: >= 30 alarms per hour (or > 10 alarms per 10 minutes) — exceeds human cognitive capacity; triggers engineering advisory for alarm rationalization (deadbands, on-delay timers, first-out suppression).

---

## 5. Flash Memory Endurance & Lifespan (TBW)

Calculated based on Total Bytes Written (TBW) against card capacity and P/E cycles:
- **Siemens SIMATIC SD (SLC)**: 60,000 P/E cycles (up to 30 years operational life).
- **Custom pSLC SD**: 20,000 P/E cycles.
- **Industrial MLC USB/SD**: 3,000 P/E cycles.
- **Consumer TLC USB/SD**: 1,000 P/E cycles.
- **Consumer QLC SD**: 300 P/E cycles.
- **Enterprise SSD**: 1,500 P/E cycles with wear leveling.

---

## 6. Master Tag Hub & TIA Portal 30-Column Specification

The Master Tag Hub generates standard 30-column Excel (`.xlsx`) files adhering to Siemens TIA Portal specification:
1. Name
2. Path
3. Connection
4. PLC tag
5. DataType
6. HMI DataType
7. Length
8. Address
9. Access Method
10. Indirect addressing
11. Index tag
12. Start value
13. Value deadband
14. Acquisition mode
15. Acquisition cycle
16. Range Maximum Type
17. Range Maximum
18. Range Minimum Type
19. Range Minimum
20. Linear scaling
21. End value PLC
22. Start value PLC
23. End value HMI
24. Start value HMI
25. Comment
26. HMI Access
27. Visible in HMI
28. Logging Mode
29. Scope
30. Substitute Value Usage (Sheet 2)

Compatible with TIA Portal V13 SP1, V14, V15, V15.1, V16, V17, V18, V19, and V20.
